display_title: The Hero Who Has Sex With a Demon
description:
It has been a year since the Demon King was defeated. Belphegor, a former high-ranking officer in the Demon King’s army, had been living a life of debauchery and idleness. Unable to bear witness to this any longer, his aide, Media, issues an order to Belphegor. 

*“Belphegor, go kill the hero.”*

Reluctantly heading to the human world, Belphegor was looking for an opportunity to assassinate the hero when he accidentally discovered the hero’s secret... The hero wasn’t actually a man, but a woman?! Having learned the hero’s secret, Belphegor proposed a deal, promising to lift the curse, and so began their awkward journey together.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
